# Performance tests 

# 1. All conditions

## Classification: Genes

OLD
```{r}
#Import ============
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "Gene sets", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))
#Metadata
all_human_mouse_metadata = readRDS(here("tables", "processed_data", "all_human_mouse_metadata.rds"))
#DEGs table
all_degs_human_mouse =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "all_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs_matched.rds")) %>%
  mutate(timepoint = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Burn", "Trauma") & timepoint %in% c("2h", "Early hours"), "Early hours", timepoint))

#Duplicate infection timepoints in human to match the mouse
all_human_mouse_metadata_matched =
  bind_rows(
    all_human_mouse_metadata %>%
      filter(!(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli") & organism == "Human")) %>%
      select(pathogen, organism, timepoint),

  #Duplicate Human infection timepoints with mouse
  all_human_mouse_metadata %>%
  filter((pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli") & organism == "Human")) %>%
  select(pathogen, organism) %>%
  inner_join(all_human_mouse_metadata %>%
               filter(organism == "Mouse",
                      pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli")) %>%
               select(pathogen, timepoint) %>%
               distinct(),
             by = "pathogen")
  ) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, organism, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(n = n())

#Join tables
all_degs_human_mouse_matched = all_degs_human_mouse %>%
       inner_join(all_human_mouse_metadata_matched,
               by = join_by("pathogen", "organism", "timepoint"))

#Print
all_degs_human_mouse_matched


#Input ======================
dge_long_genes = all_degs_human_mouse_matched %>%
  select(pathogen, treatment, organism, human_symbol, timepoint, mean_l2fc, adj_p_val, everything())

dge_long_genes %>% dplyr::count(pathogen,organism,  timepoint)

#All genes
genes_roc_allgenes = dge_long_genes
#Filter immune genes
genes_roc_allgenes_immunegenes = dge_long_genes %>%
  filter(human_symbol %in% c(btm_annotation_genes %>%
                         filter(module_category == "immune") %>%
                         pull(symbol) %>%
                         unique()))

#Only DEGs
degs_genes_human = dge_long_genes %>%
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05,
         organism == "Human") %>%
  select(human_symbol, pathogen, organism, timepoint)

#Only immune DEGs
genes_roc_DEGs_all = dge_long_genes %>%
  inner_join(degs_genes_human %>%
               select(-organism),
             by = join_by("human_symbol", "pathogen", "timepoint"))

#Only immune DEGs
genes_roc_DEGs_immune = dge_long_genes %>%
  inner_join(degs_genes_human %>%
               select(-organism),
             by = join_by("human_symbol", "pathogen", "timepoint")) %>%
  #Filter immune genes only
  filter(human_symbol %in% c(btm_annotation_genes$symbol %>% unique()))


degs_genes_human %>%
  dplyr::count(pathogen, organism, timepoint)

genes_roc_DEGs_all %>%
  dplyr::count(pathogen, organism, timepoint)

genes_roc_DEGs_immune %>%
  dplyr::count(pathogen, timepoint)

```

Inputs
Double check the code
```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=10}
set.seed(123)
# ######## Input -----
filename = "all_human_mouse_unicaudal"
gene_set_filename = "All_OnlyImmune"
genes_df_input = bind_rows(
  genes_roc_allgenes %>% mutate(model_type = "Mouse"),
  genes_roc_allgenes_immunegenes %>% mutate(model_type = "Immune")
)

```

Compute probabilities
```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=10}
#=====================================================
# Compute probabilities
#=====================================================

# OLD
# Up
dge_long_genes_up <-
  genes_df_input %>%
  mutate(
    df = n - 1,
    pval_one_sided = pt(t, df, lower.tail = FALSE),
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj <= 0.05 & t > 0, "up", "not_up"),
    prob = 1 - pval_one_sided_adj
  ) %>%
  select(-adj_p_val) %>%
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj)

# Down
dge_long_genes_down = genes_df_input %>%
  mutate(
    df = n - 1,
    pval_one_sided = pt(t, df, lower.tail = TRUE),
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj <= 0.05 & t < 0, "down", "not_down"),
    prob = 1 - pval_one_sided_adj
  ) %>%
  select(-adj_p_val) %>%
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj)

# # BICAUDAL
# # Up
# dge_long_genes_up = genes_df_input %>%
# mutate(
#   # Classify genes based on statistical significance (FDR) and direction of change
#   direction = case_when(
#     adj_p_val <= 0.05 & mean_l2fc > 0 ~ "up",
#     TRUE                              ~ "not_up"
#   ),
#   # Assign a probability score based on confidence (1 - FDR)
#   prob = 1 - adj_p_val
# )
# 
# #Down
# dge_long_genes_down = genes_df_input %>%
#   mutate(
#     # Classify genes based on statistical significance (FDR) and direction of change
#     direction = case_when(
#       adj_p_val <= 0.05 & mean_l2fc < 0 ~ "down",
#       TRUE                              ~ "not_down"
#     ),
#     # Assign a probability score based on confidence (1 - FDR)
#     prob = 1 - adj_p_val
#   )

#=====================================================
# Assign human truth
#=====================================================
truth_human_up = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  select(human_symbol, pathogen, organism, timepoint, adj_p_val, direction) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism, values_from = direction) %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")


truth_human_down = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  select(human_symbol, pathogen, organism, timepoint, adj_p_val, direction) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism, values_from = direction) %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

#=====================================================
#Generate reference distributions
#=====================================================
perfect_prediction_up = truth_human_up %>%
  mutate(prob = if_else(truth == "up", 1, 0),
         model = "Human") %>%
  rename(pred = truth)

permutation_prediction_up = perfect_prediction_up %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()), organism = "Permutation",
         model = "Permutation")

perfect_prediction_down = truth_human_down %>%
  mutate(prob = if_else(truth == "down", 1, 0),
          model = "Human") %>%
  rename(pred = truth)

permutation_prediction_down = perfect_prediction_down %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()), 
         organism = "Permutation",
         model = "Permutation")

#=====================================================
# Combine models (Mouse + Immune + Permutation + Perfect)
#=====================================================
models_up = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         organism,
         model = if_else(model_type == "Immune", "Immune", organism)) %>%
  bind_rows(perfect_prediction_up, permutation_prediction_up)

models_down = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         model = if_else(model_type == "Immune", "Immune", organism)) %>%
  bind_rows(perfect_prediction_down, permutation_prediction_down)

#=====================================================
# Classify probabilities 
#=====================================================
classified_df_probs_up = truth_human_up %>% 
  select(human_symbol, pathogen, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_up %>% 
               select(human_symbol, organism, pathogen, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(human_symbol, timepoint, pathogen)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("up", "not_up"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct()

classified_df_probs_down = truth_human_down %>% 
  select(human_symbol, pathogen, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_down %>% 
               select(human_symbol, organism, pathogen, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(human_symbol, timepoint, pathogen)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("down", "not_down"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct() 


classified_df_probs_up_DEGs = truth_human_up %>% 
  select(human_symbol, pathogen, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_up %>% 
               select(human_symbol, organism, pathogen, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(human_symbol, timepoint, pathogen)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("up", "not_up"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
    inner_join(degs_genes_human %>% 
               select(-organism), 
             by = join_by(human_symbol, pathogen, timepoint))



classified_df_probs_down_DEGs = truth_human_down %>% 
  select(human_symbol, pathogen, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_down %>% 
               select(human_symbol, organism, pathogen, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(human_symbol, timepoint, pathogen)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("down", "not_down"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct()  %>% 
    inner_join(degs_genes_human %>% 
               select(-organism), 
             by = join_by(human_symbol, pathogen, timepoint))

classified_df_probs_up %>%
  group_by(pathogen, model, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(has_up = "up" %in% truth) %>%
  filter(!has_up)
classified_df_probs_up_DEGs %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, model, timepoint)

classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, model, timepoint)
classified_df_probs_down_DEGs %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, model, timepoint)
```

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=10}
roc_curve_up_notup = classified_df_probs_up %>%

  # FILTRO DE SEGURANÇA: verifica se ambos os níveis ("up" e "notup") existem

  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up")

auc_results_up = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  mutate(truth = fct_relevel(truth, "up", after = 0)) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human")) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, model, timepoint) %>%
    # FILTRO DE SEGURANÇA: verifica se ambos os níveis ("up" e "notup") existem
  filter(n_distinct(truth) > 1) %>%
  roc_auc(truth, prob) %>%
  rename(auc = .estimate) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(pathogen, model, timepoint, auc, comparison)

##### Unite all results
roc_curve_auc_df = bind_rows(auc_results_up,
                             auc_results_down) %>% 
  inner_join(
    roc_curve_up_notup %>% 
      bind_rows(roc_curve_down_notdown %>% 
                  filter(model != "Human")),
    by = join_by(pathogen, model, timepoint, comparison)) %>% 
    mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("Human", "Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation")),
         comparison = factor(comparison, levels = c("Up", "Down")),
         # timepoint = str_replace(timepoint, "Early hours", "Early\nhours"),
         timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, c("Early hours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
         pathogen = case_when(pathogen == "Hepatitis B" ~ "HepB",
                              pathogen == "Staphylococcus aureus" ~ "S. aureus",
                              pathogen == "Escherichia coli" ~ "E. coli",
                              T ~ pathogen),
         pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "HepB", "S. aureus", "E. coli", "Burn", "Trauma")) %>% 
  mutate(auc = round(auc, 2) %>% as.character())
```

### Plot ROC curve
All genes
```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=10}
#Plot curves ------------------
#PLOT ROC Curve
roc_curve_plot = roc_curve_auc_df %>% 
  # mutate(comparison = as.character(comparison),
  #        comparison = if_else(comparison == "Up", "U", "D")) %>% 
  arrange(pathogen) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = 1 - specificity, 
             y = sensitivity, 
             color = model,
             linetype = comparison)) +
  geom_path(size = 0.75, alpha = 1) +
  geom_abline(lty = 3) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  facet_nested_wrap(~pathogen+timepoint, nrow = 3, axes = "x",
                    strip = strip_nested(size = "variable")) +
  #Mouse
  geom_text(data = . %>% 
              filter(model == "Mouse", comparison == "Up") %>% 
              select(pathogen, model, comparison, timepoint, auc) %>% 
              distinct(),
            mapping = aes(label = paste(comparison, auc),

  geom_text(data = . %>% 
              filter(model == "Mouse", comparison == "Down") %>%

              distinct(),
            mapping = aes(label = paste(comparison, auc),

  #Immune
  geom_text(data = . %>%

                                   "Down" = 2)) +
  # coord_equal() +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors$organism) +
  labs(
  x = "FPR",
  y = "TPR",
  color = "Model",
  linetype = "Comparison") + 
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4)),
         color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 4, shape = 1))
         ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 8),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8),

          legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "cm"),
          panel.spacing.y = unit(0, "lines"), 
          panel.spacing.x = unit(1, "lines"), 
          plot.margin = margin(0, 0.3, 0, 0, unit = "cm"),
          
          ) +
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 3) +
```

```{r fig.height=12, fig.width=3}

#Get n genes
ngenes = bind_rows(
  classified_df_probs_up %>%
    filter(pred == "up") %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint, model) %>% 
  summarise(n_genes = n(),
            comparison = "Up") %>% 
    ungroup(),
  classified_df_probs_down %>%
    filter(pred == "down") %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint, model) %>% 
  summarise(n_genes = n(),
            comparison = "Down") %>% 
    ungroup(),
)


# Visualize AUC
auc_lineplot_df <- bind_rows(auc_results_up,
                      auc_results_down) %>%
  inner_join(ngenes, by = join_by(comparison, pathogen, timepoint, model)) %>% 
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("Human", "Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation")),
         comparison = factor(comparison, levels = c("Up", "Down")),
         timepoint = str_replace(timepoint, "Early hours", "Early\nhours"),
         timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, c("Early\nhours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
         pathogen = case_when(pathogen == "Hepatitis B" ~ "HepB",
                              pathogen == "Staphylococcus aureus" ~ "S. aureus",
                              pathogen == "Escherichia coli" ~ "E. coli",
                              T ~ pathogen),
         pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "HepB", "S. aureus", "E. coli", "Burn", "Trauma"),
         treatment = case_when(pathogen %in% c("HepB", "Influenza") ~ "Vaccination",
                               pathogen %in% c( "S. aureus", "E. coli") ~ "Infection",
                               pathogen %in% c( "Burn", "Trauma") ~ "Injury",
                               T ~ pathogen),
         treatment = fct_relevel(treatment, "Vaccination", "Infection", "Injury")
         ) 

auc_lineplot = auc_lineplot_df %>% 
  ggplot() +
   aes(x = timepoint,
      y = auc,
      fill = model,
      color = model,
      group = model) + 
  
  facet_nested_wrap(~treatment+pathogen+comparison,
                    scales = "free",
                    ncol = 2,
                    strip = strip_nested(size = "variable")
                    ) +
  
  geom_line(width = 1,
            aes(linetype = model)) +
  
  geom_point(size = 2,
             pch = 21,
             color = "black",
             stroke = 0.5) + 
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = n_genes), size = 2) +
  # Add a reference line for random prediction (AUC = 0.5)
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  # geom_text_repel(aes(label = auc), 
  #                 size = 2.5, 
  #                 # direction = "y", 
  #                 segment.alpha = 1) +

  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0.05, 0.05)) +
  # scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(
    "Mouse" = 1,
    "Immune" = 1,
    "Human" = 1,
    "Permutation" = 2
    )) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors$organism) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors$organism) +
  labs(
    x = "Time",
    y = "AUC",
    fill = "Model",
    shape = "Model",
  ) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0,  hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 8),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 1),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 8, margin = margin(1, 0, 1, 0)),
          strip.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, size = 8),
          strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 8),
          panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"),
          plot.margin = margin(0, 0.5, 0, 0, unit = "cm"),
          legend.position = "top",
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.margin=margin(0,0,0,0),
          legend.box.margin=margin(0,0,-10,0),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
          ggh4x.facet.nestline = element_line(colour = "black", linetype = 1, size = 0.5)
    ) +
  guides(color = "none",
         shape = "none",
         linetype = "none",
         fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, by.row = T))

         width = 3,
```

## 2. Classification: BTMs

### Means

```{r}
#Import ========================
#Unite BTM means
dge_btm_mean_process_saureus = readRDS(file = here("tables", paste0("saureus_human_mouse_dge_btm_mean_process.rds")))
dge_btm_mean_process_ecoli = readRDS(file = here("tables", paste0("ecoli_human_mouse_dge_btm_mean_process.rds")))
dge_btm_mean_process_fluad = readRDS(file = here("tables", paste0("influenza_human_mouse_dge_btm_mean_process.rds")))
dge_btm_mean_process_engerix  = readRDS(file = here("tables", paste0("hepatitisb_human_mouse_dge_btm_mean_process.rds")))
dge_btm_mean_process_trauma  = readRDS(file = here("tables", paste0("trauma_human_mouse_dge_btm_mean_process.rds")))
dge_btm_mean_process_burn  = readRDS(file = here("tables", paste0("burn_human_mouse_dge_btm_mean_process.rds")))

dge_btm_mean_process_all = bind_rows(
  dge_btm_mean_process_saureus,
  dge_btm_mean_process_ecoli,
  dge_btm_mean_process_fluad %>% mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint)),
  dge_btm_mean_process_engerix %>% mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint)),
  dge_btm_mean_process_burn,
  dge_btm_mean_process_trauma
) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Burn", "Trauma") & timepoint == "2h", "Early hours", timepoint),
         pathogen = case_when(pathogen == "Saureus" ~ "Staphylococcus aureus",
                              pathogen == "Ecoli" ~ "Escherichia coli",
                              T~pathogen)) %>% 
  #Annotate timepoints
  mutate(timepoint = case_when(pathogen %in% c("Influenza", "Hepatitis B") ~ paste0("Day ", timepoint),
                               pathogen %in% c("Escherichia coli", "Staphylococcus aureus") ~ paste0(timepoint, "h"),
                               T ~timepoint),
         timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, c("Early hours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
         timepoint_comparison = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Escherichia coli", "Staphylococcus aureus"),
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", "24h"), 
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", timepoint)) %>% 
                                str_replace(., "Early hours-Early hours", "2h-Early")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, c("Early hours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")))

dge_btm_mean_process_all %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, organism, timepoint)


#Import ============
#Import DEGs table
dge_btm_mean_process = dge_btm_mean_process_all

#Import metadata
#Metadata 
all_human_mouse_metadata = readRDS(here("tables", "processed_data", "all_human_mouse_metadata.rds")) %>% 
  filter(!(timepoint %in% c("0h", "Day 0")))

all_human_mouse_metadata_matched = bind_rows(
  # 1. Keep everything for OTHER pathogens (neither S. aureus nor E. coli)
  all_human_mouse_metadata %>% 
    filter(!(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli"))) %>% 
    select(pathogen, organism, timepoint),
    
  # 2. Keep the original MOUSE timepoints for S. aureus and E. coli
  all_human_mouse_metadata %>% 
    filter(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli") & organism == "Mouse") %>% 
    select(pathogen, organism, timepoint),
    
  # 3. Create the HUMAN timepoints mapped to Mouse timepoints for these pathogens
  all_human_mouse_metadata %>% 
    filter(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli") & organism == "Human") %>% 
    select(pathogen, organism) %>% # Keep 'Human' label, drop original timepoint
    inner_join(
      all_human_mouse_metadata %>% 
        filter(organism == "Mouse", 
               pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli")) %>%
        select(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
        distinct(),
      by = "pathogen"
    )
) %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, organism, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  ungroup()



#Pre-process data =============

all_btms_human_mouse_matched = bind_rows(
  # 1. Keep everything that is NOT S. aureus or E. coli
  dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
    filter(!(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli"))),
  
  # 2. Keep the original MOUSE data for S. aureus and E. coli
  dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
    filter(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli") & organism == "Mouse"),
    
  # 3. Add the DUPLICATED HUMAN data mapped to Mouse timepoints
  dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
    filter(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli") & organism == "Human") %>% 
    select(-timepoint) %>% 
    inner_join(
      all_human_mouse_metadata_matched %>% 
        filter(organism == "Mouse", 
               pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli")) %>%
        select(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
        distinct(),
      by = "pathogen"
    )
)

all_btms_human_mouse_matched %>% select(pathogen, organism, timepoint, ) %>% distinct()

all_btms_human_mouse = all_btms_human_mouse_matched %>% 
  inner_join(all_human_mouse_metadata_matched,
               by = join_by("pathogen", "organism", "timepoint")) %>% 
  distinct()
#Check
all_btms_human_mouse %>% select(pathogen, organism, timepoint, ) %>% distinct()

#Input ======================
set.seed(123)
filename = "all_human_mouse"
gene_set_filename = "BTMs"

btms_df_input = all_btms_human_mouse_matched %>% 
  rename(symbol = process)
```


Calculate ROC curve


```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
#=====================================================
# Compute probabilities
#=====================================================

dge_long_genes_up = btms_df_input %>% 
  mutate(
    df = n_genes - 1,
    t = mean_log2fc/(sd_log2fc/sqrt(n_genes)), 
    pval_one_sided = pt(t, df, lower.tail = FALSE),
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj <= 0.05 & t > 0, "up", "not_up"),
    prob = 1 - pval_one_sided_adj
  ) %>%
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj)

dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  filter(pathogen == "Staphylococcus aureus",
         organism == "Human")

dge_long_genes_down = btms_df_input %>% 
  mutate(
    df = n_genes - 1,
    t = mean_log2fc/(sd_log2fc/sqrt(n_genes)), 
    pval_one_sided = pt(t, df, lower.tail = TRUE),
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj <= 0.05 & t < 0, "down", "not_down"),
    prob = 1 - pval_one_sided_adj
  ) %>%
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj) %>% 
  drop_na(adj_p_val)

dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  filter(pathogen == "Staphylococcus aureus",
         organism == "Human")

#=====================================================
# Assign human truth
#=====================================================
truth_human_up = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  select(pathogen, symbol, organism, timepoint, adj_p_val, direction) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism, values_from = direction) %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human") 

truth_human_down = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  select(pathogen, symbol, organism, timepoint, adj_p_val, direction) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism, values_from = direction) %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

truth_human_up %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, organism, timepoint)

#=====================================================
#Generate reference distributions
#=====================================================
perfect_prediction_up = truth_human_up %>%
  mutate(prob = if_else(truth == "up", 1, 0),
         model = "Human") %>%
  rename(pred = truth) 

permutation_prediction_up = perfect_prediction_up %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()), organism = "Permutation",
         model = "Permutation")%>% 
  drop_na(pred)

perfect_prediction_down = truth_human_down %>%
  mutate(prob = if_else(truth == "down", 1, 0),
          model = "Human") %>%
  rename(pred = truth) %>% 
  drop_na(pred)

permutation_prediction_down = perfect_prediction_down %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()), organism = "Permutation",
         model = "Permutation") %>% 
  drop_na(prob)


perfect_prediction_down %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, model, timepoint)

#=====================================================
# Combine models (Mouse + Immune + Permutation + Perfect)
#=====================================================
models_up = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         model = organism) %>%
  bind_rows(perfect_prediction_up, permutation_prediction_up) %>% 
  drop_na(prob)

models_down = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         model = organism) %>%
  bind_rows(perfect_prediction_down, permutation_prediction_down) %>% 
  drop_na(prob)

models_down %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, model, timepoint)

#=====================================================
# Classify probabilities 
#=====================================================
classified_df_probs_up = truth_human_up %>% 
  select(pathogen, symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_up %>% 
               select(pathogen, symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(pathogen, symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("up", "not_up"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct()

classified_df_probs_down = truth_human_down %>% 
  select(pathogen, symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_down %>% 
               select(pathogen, symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(pathogen, symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("down", "not_down"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct()

classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, model, timepoint)

#=====================================================
#Compute ROC 
#=====================================================

roc_curve_up_notup = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human")) %>%
  drop_na() %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up")

roc_curve_down_notdown = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human")) %>%
  drop_na() %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Down")

roc_curve_up_notup %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, model, timepoint)

#=====================================================
#Compute AUC 
#=====================================================
auc_results_up = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  mutate(truth = fct_relevel(truth, "up", after = 0)) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_auc(truth, prob) %>%
  rename(auc = .estimate) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(pathogen, model, timepoint, auc, comparison)

auc_results_down = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  mutate(truth = fct_relevel(truth, "down", after = 0)) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_auc(truth, prob) %>%
  rename(auc = .estimate) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Down") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(pathogen, model, timepoint, auc, comparison)

auc_results_down %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, model, timepoint)


#=====================================================
#Unite all results
#=====================================================
roc_curve_auc_df = bind_rows(auc_results_up,auc_results_down) %>% 
  inner_join(
    roc_curve_up_notup %>% 
      bind_rows(roc_curve_down_notdown %>% 
                  filter(model != "Human")),
    by = join_by(pathogen, model, timepoint, comparison)) %>% 
    mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("Human", "Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation")),
         comparison = factor(comparison, levels = c("Up", "Down")),
         # timepoint = str_replace(timepoint, "Early hours", "Early\nhours"),
         timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, c("Early hours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
         pathogen = case_when(pathogen == "Hepatitis B" ~ "HepB",
                              pathogen == "Staphylococcus aureus" ~ "S. aureus",
                              pathogen == "Escherichia coli" ~ "E. coli",
                              T ~ pathogen),
         pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "HepB", "S. aureus", "E. coli", "Burn", "Trauma")) %>% 
  mutate(auc = round(auc, 2) %>% as.character())

roc_curve_auc_df %>% 
  select(pathogen, model, comparison, timepoint, auc) %>% 
  filter(model == "Immune") %>% 
              distinct()
```

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=12}
         timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, c("Early\nhours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
         pathogen = case_when(pathogen == "Hepatitis B" ~ "HepB",
                              pathogen == "Staphylococcus aureus" ~ "S. aureus",
                              pathogen == "Escherichia coli" ~ "E. coli",
                              T ~ pathogen),
         pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "HepB", "S. aureus", "E. coli", "Burn", "Trauma"),
         treatment = case_when(pathogen %in% c("HepB", "Influenza") ~ "Vaccination",
                               pathogen %in% c( "S. aureus", "E. coli") ~ "Infection",
                               pathogen %in% c( "Burn", "Trauma") ~ "Injury",
                               T ~ pathogen),
         treatment = fct_relevel(treatment, "Vaccination", "Infection", "Injury")
         )

  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +

  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0.05, 0.05)) +

  theme_vaxgo() +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(

    "Immune" = 1,
```

```{r}
#Unite BTM means and NES
gsea_btm_results_saureus = readRDS(here("tables", paste0("saureus_human_mouse_gsea_btm_results.rds")))
gsea_btm_results_ecoli = readRDS(here("tables", paste0("ecoli_human_mouse_gsea_btm_results.rds")))
gsea_btm_results_fluad = readRDS(here("tables", paste0("influenza_human_mouse_gsea_btm_results.rds")))
gsea_btm_results_engerix = readRDS(here("tables", paste0("hepatitisb_human_mouse_gsea_btm_results.rds")))
gsea_btm_results_burn = readRDS(here("tables", paste0("burn_human_mouse_gsea_btm_results.rds")))
gsea_btm_results_trauma = readRDS(here("tables", paste0("trauma_human_mouse_gsea_btm_results.rds")))

gsea_btm_results_all = bind_rows(
  gsea_btm_results_saureus,
  gsea_btm_results_ecoli,
  gsea_btm_results_fluad %>% mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint)),
  gsea_btm_results_engerix %>% mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint)),
  gsea_btm_results_trauma,
  gsea_btm_results_burn
)%>% 
  mutate(timepoint = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Burn", "Trauma") & timepoint == "2h", "Early hours", timepoint),
         pathogen = case_when(pathogen == "Saureus" ~ "Staphylococcus aureus",
                              pathogen == "Ecoli" ~ "Escherichia coli",
                              T~pathogen)) %>% 
  #Annotate timepoints
  mutate(timepoint = case_when(pathogen %in% c("Influenza", "Hepatitis B") ~ paste0("Day ", timepoint),
                               pathogen %in% c("Escherichia coli", "Staphylococcus aureus") ~ paste0(timepoint, "h"),
                               T ~timepoint),
         timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, c("Early hours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
         timepoint_comparison = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Escherichia coli", "Staphylococcus aureus"),
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", "24h"), 
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", timepoint)) %>% 
                                str_replace(., "Early hours-Early hours", "2h-Early")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, c("Early hours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")))


#Import ============
#Import DEGs table
dge_btm_mean_process = gsea_btm_results_all

#Import metadata
#Metadata 
all_human_mouse_metadata = readRDS(here("tables", "processed_data", "all_human_mouse_metadata.rds")) %>% 
  filter(!(timepoint %in% c("0h", "Day 0")))

all_human_mouse_metadata_matched = bind_rows(
  # 1. Keep everything for OTHER pathogens (neither S. aureus nor E. coli)
  all_human_mouse_metadata %>% 
    filter(!(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli"))) %>% 
    select(pathogen, organism, timepoint),
    
  # 2. Keep the original MOUSE timepoints for S. aureus and E. coli
  all_human_mouse_metadata %>% 
    filter(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli") & organism == "Mouse") %>% 
    select(pathogen, organism, timepoint),
    
  # 3. Create the HUMAN timepoints mapped to Mouse timepoints for these pathogens
  all_human_mouse_metadata %>% 
    filter(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli") & organism == "Human") %>% 
    select(pathogen, organism) %>% # Keep 'Human' label, drop original timepoint
    inner_join(
      all_human_mouse_metadata %>% 
        filter(organism == "Mouse", 
               pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli")) %>%
        select(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
        distinct(),
      by = "pathogen"
    )
) %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, organism, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  ungroup()



#Pre-process data =============

all_btms_human_mouse_matched = bind_rows(
  # 1. Keep everything that is NOT S. aureus or E. coli
  dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
    filter(!(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli"))),
  
  # 2. Keep the original MOUSE data for S. aureus and E. coli
  dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
    filter(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli") & organism == "Mouse"),
    
  # 3. Add the DUPLICATED HUMAN data mapped to Mouse timepoints
  dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
    filter(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli") & organism == "Human") %>% 
    select(-timepoint) %>% 
    inner_join(
      all_human_mouse_metadata_matched %>% 
        filter(organism == "Mouse", 
               pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli")) %>%
        select(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
        distinct(),
      by = "pathogen"
    )
)

all_btms_human_mouse_matched %>% select(pathogen, organism, timepoint, ) %>% distinct()

all_btms_human_mouse = all_btms_human_mouse_matched %>% 
  inner_join(all_human_mouse_metadata_matched,
               by = join_by("pathogen", "organism", "timepoint")) %>% 
  distinct()
#Check

#Input ======================

gene_set_filename = "BTMs_NES"
```

#### Significant Up/Down vs Not-significant Up/Down

Calculate ROC curve
```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
#=====================================================
# Compute probabilities
#=====================================================

dge_long_genes_up = btms_df_input %>% 
  mutate(
    df = n_genes - 1,
    t = nes/(sd_log2fc/sqrt(n_genes)), 
    pval_one_sided = pt(t, df, lower.tail = FALSE),
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj <= 0.05 & t > 0, "up", "not_up"),
    prob = 1 - pval_one_sided_adj
  ) %>%
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj)

dge_long_genes_down = btms_df_input %>% 
  mutate(
    df = n_genes - 1,
    t = nes/(sd_log2fc/sqrt(n_genes)), 
    pval_one_sided = pt(t, df, lower.tail = TRUE),
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj <= 0.05 & t < 0, "down", "not_down"),
    prob = 1 - pval_one_sided_adj
  ) %>%
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj) %>% 
  drop_na(adj_p_val)


#=====================================================
# Assign human truth
#=====================================================
truth_human_up = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  select(pathogen, symbol, organism, timepoint, adj_p_val, direction) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism, values_from = direction) %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human") 

truth_human_down = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  select(pathogen, symbol, organism, timepoint, adj_p_val, direction) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism, values_from = direction) %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

truth_human_up %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, organism, timepoint)

#=====================================================
#Generate reference distributions
#=====================================================
perfect_prediction_up = truth_human_up %>%
  mutate(prob = if_else(truth == "up", 1, 0),
         model = "Human") %>%
  rename(pred = truth) 

permutation_prediction_up = perfect_prediction_up %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()), organism = "Permutation",
         model = "Permutation")%>% 
  drop_na(pred)

perfect_prediction_down = truth_human_down %>%
  mutate(prob = if_else(truth == "down", 1, 0),
          model = "Human") %>%
  rename(pred = truth) %>% 
  drop_na(pred)

permutation_prediction_down = perfect_prediction_down %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()), organism = "Permutation",
         model = "Permutation") %>% 
  drop_na(prob)


perfect_prediction_down %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, model, timepoint)

#=====================================================
# Combine models (Mouse + Immune + Permutation + Perfect)
#=====================================================
models_up = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         model = organism) %>%
  bind_rows(perfect_prediction_up, permutation_prediction_up) %>% 
  drop_na(prob)

models_down = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         model = organism) %>%
  bind_rows(perfect_prediction_down, permutation_prediction_down) %>% 
  drop_na(prob)

models_down %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, model, timepoint)

#=====================================================
# Classify probabilities 
#=====================================================
classified_df_probs_up = truth_human_up %>% 
  select(pathogen, symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_up %>% 
               select(pathogen, symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(pathogen, symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("up", "not_up"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct()

classified_df_probs_down = truth_human_down %>% 
  select(pathogen, symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_down %>% 
               select(pathogen, symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(pathogen, symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("down", "not_down"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct()

classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, model, timepoint)

#=====================================================
#Compute ROC 
#=====================================================

roc_curve_up_notup = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human")) %>%
  drop_na() %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up")

roc_curve_down_notdown = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human")) %>%
  drop_na() %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Down")

roc_curve_up_notup %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, model, timepoint)

#=====================================================
#Compute AUC 
#=====================================================
auc_results_up = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  mutate(truth = fct_relevel(truth, "up", after = 0)) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_auc(truth, prob) %>%
  rename(auc = .estimate) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(pathogen, model, timepoint, auc, comparison)

auc_results_down = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  mutate(truth = fct_relevel(truth, "down", after = 0)) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_auc(truth, prob) %>%
  rename(auc = .estimate) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Down") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(pathogen, model, timepoint, auc, comparison)

auc_results_down %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, model, timepoint)


#=====================================================
#Unite all results
#=====================================================
roc_curve_auc_df = bind_rows(auc_results_up,auc_results_down) %>% 
  inner_join(
    roc_curve_up_notup %>% 
      bind_rows(roc_curve_down_notdown %>% 
                  filter(model != "Human")),
    by = join_by(pathogen, model, timepoint, comparison)) %>% 
    mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("Human", "Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation")),
         comparison = factor(comparison, levels = c("Up", "Down")),
         # timepoint = str_replace(timepoint, "Early hours", "Early\nhours"),
         timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, c("Early hours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
         pathogen = case_when(pathogen == "Hepatitis B" ~ "HepB",
                              pathogen == "Staphylococcus aureus" ~ "S. aureus",
                              pathogen == "Escherichia coli" ~ "E. coli",
                              T ~ pathogen),
         pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "HepB", "S. aureus", "E. coli", "Burn", "Trauma")) %>% 
  mutate(auc = round(auc, 2) %>% as.character())
```

```{r}
dge_hallmarks_mean_process_all %>%

#Import ============
#Import DEGs table
dge_hallmarks_mean_process = dge_hallmarks_mean_process_all

#Import metadata
#Metadata 
all_human_mouse_metadata = readRDS(here("tables", "processed_data", "all_human_mouse_metadata.rds")) %>% 
  filter(!(timepoint %in% c("0h", "Day 0")))

all_human_mouse_metadata_matched = bind_rows(
  # 1. Keep everything for OTHER pathogens (neither S. aureus nor E. coli)
  all_human_mouse_metadata %>% 
    filter(!(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli"))) %>% 
    select(pathogen, organism, timepoint),
    
  # 2. Keep the original MOUSE timepoints for S. aureus and E. coli
  all_human_mouse_metadata %>% 
    filter(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli") & organism == "Mouse") %>% 
    select(pathogen, organism, timepoint),
    
  # 3. Create the HUMAN timepoints mapped to Mouse timepoints for these pathogens
  all_human_mouse_metadata %>% 
    filter(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli") & organism == "Human") %>% 
    select(pathogen, organism) %>% # Keep 'Human' label, drop original timepoint
    inner_join(
      all_human_mouse_metadata %>% 
        filter(organism == "Mouse", 
               pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli")) %>%
        select(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
        distinct(),
      by = "pathogen"
    )
) %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, organism, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  ungroup()

all_hallmarks_human_mouse_matched = bind_rows(
  # 1. Keep everything that is NOT S. aureus or E. coli
  dge_hallmarks_mean_process %>%

  # 2. Keep the original MOUSE data for S. aureus and E. coli
  dge_hallmarks_mean_process %>% 
    filter(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli") & organism == "Mouse"),
    
  # 3. Add the DUPLICATED HUMAN data mapped to Mouse timepoints
  dge_hallmarks_mean_process %>% 
    filter(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli") & organism == "Human") %>% 
    select(-timepoint) %>% 
    inner_join(
      all_human_mouse_metadata_matched %>% 
        filter(organism == "Mouse", 
               pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli")) %>%
        select(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
        distinct(),
      by = "pathogen"
    )
)

all_hallmarks_human_mouse_matched %>% select(pathogen, organism, timepoint, ) %>% distinct()

all_hallmarks_human_mouse = all_hallmarks_human_mouse_matched %>%

```


Calculate ROC curve


```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
#=====================================================
# Compute probabilities
#=====================================================

dge_long_genes_up = hallmarks_df_input %>% 
  mutate(
    df = n_genes - 1,
    t = mean_log2fc/(sd_log2fc/sqrt(n_genes)), 
    pval_one_sided = pt(t, df, lower.tail = FALSE),
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj <= 0.05 & t > 0, "up", "not_up"),
    prob = 1 - pval_one_sided_adj
  ) %>%
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj)

dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  filter(pathogen == "Staphylococcus aureus",
         organism == "Human")

dge_long_genes_down = hallmarks_df_input %>% 
  mutate(
    df = n_genes - 1,
    t = mean_log2fc/(sd_log2fc/sqrt(n_genes)), 
    pval_one_sided = pt(t, df, lower.tail = TRUE),
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj <= 0.05 & t < 0, "down", "not_down"),
    prob = 1 - pval_one_sided_adj
  ) %>%
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj) %>% 
  drop_na(adj_p_val)

dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  filter(pathogen == "Staphylococcus aureus",
         organism == "Human")

#=====================================================
# Assign human truth
#=====================================================
truth_human_up = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  select(pathogen, symbol, organism, timepoint, adj_p_val, direction) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism, values_from = direction) %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human") 

truth_human_down = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  select(pathogen, symbol, organism, timepoint, adj_p_val, direction) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism, values_from = direction) %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

truth_human_up %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, organism, timepoint)

#=====================================================
#Generate reference distributions
#=====================================================
perfect_prediction_up = truth_human_up %>%
  mutate(prob = if_else(truth == "up", 1, 0),
         model = "Human") %>%
  rename(pred = truth) 

permutation_prediction_up = perfect_prediction_up %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()), organism = "Permutation",
         model = "Permutation")%>% 
  drop_na(pred)

perfect_prediction_down = truth_human_down %>%
  mutate(prob = if_else(truth == "down", 1, 0),
          model = "Human") %>%
  rename(pred = truth) %>% 
  drop_na(pred)

permutation_prediction_down = perfect_prediction_down %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()), organism = "Permutation",
         model = "Permutation") %>% 
  drop_na(prob)


perfect_prediction_down %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, model, timepoint)

#=====================================================
# Combine models (Mouse + Immune + Permutation + Perfect)
#=====================================================
models_up = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         model = organism) %>%
  bind_rows(perfect_prediction_up, permutation_prediction_up) %>% 
  drop_na(prob)

models_down = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         model = organism) %>%
  bind_rows(perfect_prediction_down, permutation_prediction_down) %>% 
  drop_na(prob)

models_down %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, model, timepoint)

#=====================================================
# Classify probabilities 
#=====================================================
classified_df_probs_up = truth_human_up %>% 
  select(pathogen, symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_up %>% 
               select(pathogen, symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(pathogen, symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("up", "not_up"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct()

classified_df_probs_down = truth_human_down %>% 
  select(pathogen, symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_down %>% 
               select(pathogen, symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(pathogen, symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("down", "not_down"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct()

classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, model, timepoint)

#=====================================================
#Compute ROC 
#=====================================================

roc_curve_up_notup = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human")) %>%
  drop_na() %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up")

roc_curve_down_notdown = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human")) %>%
  drop_na() %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Down")

roc_curve_up_notup %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, model, timepoint)

#=====================================================
#Compute AUC 
#=====================================================
auc_results_up = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  mutate(truth = fct_relevel(truth, "up", after = 0)) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_auc(truth, prob) %>%
  rename(auc = .estimate) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(pathogen, model, timepoint, auc, comparison)

auc_results_down = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  mutate(truth = fct_relevel(truth, "down", after = 0)) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_auc(truth, prob) %>%
  rename(auc = .estimate) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Down") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(pathogen, model, timepoint, auc, comparison)

auc_results_down %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, model, timepoint)

#=====================================================
#Unite all results
#=====================================================
roc_curve_auc_df = bind_rows(auc_results_up,auc_results_down) %>% 
  inner_join(
    roc_curve_up_notup %>% 
      bind_rows(roc_curve_down_notdown %>% 
                  filter(model != "Human")),
    by = join_by(pathogen, model, timepoint, comparison)) %>% 
    mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("Human", "Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation")),
         comparison = factor(comparison, levels = c("Up", "Down")),
         # timepoint = str_replace(timepoint, "Early hours", "Early\nhours"),
         timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, c("Early hours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
         pathogen = case_when(pathogen == "Hepatitis B" ~ "HepB",
                              pathogen == "Staphylococcus aureus" ~ "S. aureus",
                              pathogen == "Escherichia coli" ~ "E. coli",
                              T ~ pathogen),
         pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "HepB", "S. aureus", "E. coli", "Burn", "Trauma")) %>% 
  mutate(auc = round(auc, 2) %>% as.character())


```

```{r}
         timepoint_comparison = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Escherichia coli", "Staphylococcus aureus"),
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", "24h"),

                                str_replace(., "Early hours-Early hours", "2h-Early")) %>%
```

Calculate ROC curve


```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
#=====================================================
# Compute probabilities
#=====================================================
# The script derives a t-score by scaling the NES by the standard error of the log_2FC values within each hallmark. It then computes one-sided p-values using the Student's t-distribution, applies a Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) correction for multiple testing, and classifies pathways as significantly "up-regulated" or "down-regulated" based on a 5% False Discovery Rate (FDR) threshold.

dge_long_genes_up <- hallmarks_df_input %>% 
  mutate(
    # 1. Degrees of freedom
    df = n_genes - 1,
    
    # 2. Calculate t-statistic (NES / Standard Error)
    t = nes / (sd_log2fc / sqrt(n_genes)), 
    
    # 3. Compute one-sided p-value (upper tail)
    pval_one_sided = pt(t, df, lower.tail = FALSE),
    
    # 4. Multiple testing correction (Benjamini-Hochberg)
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    
    # 5. Classify significant up-regulation
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj <= 0.05 & t > 0, "up", "not_up"),
    
    # 6. Probability score (Complement of adjusted p-value)
    prob = 1 - pval_one_sided_adj
  ) %>%
  # Rename for consistency with downstream pipelines
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj)


dge_long_genes_down <- hallmarks_df_input %>% 
  mutate(
    df = n_genes - 1,
    t = nes / (sd_log2fc / sqrt(n_genes)), 
    # Compute one-sided p-value (lower tail for down-regulation)
    pval_one_sided = pt(t, df, lower.tail = TRUE),
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    
    # Classify significant down-regulation
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj <= 0.05 & t < 0, "down", "not_down"),
    prob = 1 - pval_one_sided_adj
  ) %>%
  # 7. Cleanup and final renaming
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj) %>% 
  drop_na(adj_p_val)


#=====================================================
# Assign human truth
#=====================================================
truth_human_up = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  select(pathogen, symbol, organism, timepoint, adj_p_val, direction) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism, values_from = direction) %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human") 

truth_human_down = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  select(pathogen, symbol, organism, timepoint, adj_p_val, direction) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism, values_from = direction) %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

truth_human_up %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, organism, timepoint)

#=====================================================
#Generate reference distributions
#=====================================================
perfect_prediction_up = truth_human_up %>%
  mutate(prob = if_else(truth == "up", 1, 0),
         model = "Human") %>%
  rename(pred = truth) 

permutation_prediction_up = perfect_prediction_up %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()), organism = "Permutation",
         model = "Permutation")%>% 
  drop_na(pred)

perfect_prediction_down = truth_human_down %>%
  mutate(prob = if_else(truth == "down", 1, 0),
          model = "Human") %>%
  rename(pred = truth) %>% 
  drop_na(pred)

permutation_prediction_down = perfect_prediction_down %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()), organism = "Permutation",
         model = "Permutation") %>% 
  drop_na(prob)


perfect_prediction_down %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, model, timepoint)

#=====================================================
# Combine models (Mouse + Immune + Permutation + Perfect)
#=====================================================
models_up = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         model = organism) %>%
  bind_rows(perfect_prediction_up, permutation_prediction_up) %>% 
  drop_na(prob)

models_down = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         model = organism) %>%
  bind_rows(perfect_prediction_down, permutation_prediction_down) %>% 
  drop_na(prob)

models_down %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, model, timepoint)

#=====================================================
# Classify probabilities 
#=====================================================
classified_df_probs_up = truth_human_up %>% 
  select(pathogen, symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_up %>% 
               select(pathogen, symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(pathogen, symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("up", "not_up"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct()

classified_df_probs_down = truth_human_down %>% 
  select(pathogen, symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_down %>% 
               select(pathogen, symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(pathogen, symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("down", "not_down"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct()

classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, model, timepoint)

#=====================================================
#Compute ROC 
#=====================================================

roc_curve_up_notup = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human")) %>%
  drop_na() %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up")

roc_curve_down_notdown = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human")) %>%
  drop_na() %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Down")

roc_curve_up_notup %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, model, timepoint)

#=====================================================
#Compute AUC 
#=====================================================
auc_results_up = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  mutate(truth = fct_relevel(truth, "up", after = 0)) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_auc(truth, prob) %>%
  rename(auc = .estimate) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(pathogen, model, timepoint, auc, comparison)

auc_results_down = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  mutate(truth = fct_relevel(truth, "down", after = 0)) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_auc(truth, prob) %>%
  rename(auc = .estimate) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Down") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(pathogen, model, timepoint, auc, comparison)

auc_results_down %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, model, timepoint)
#=====================================================
#Unite all results
#=====================================================
roc_curve_auc_df = bind_rows(auc_results_up,auc_results_down) %>% 
  inner_join(
    roc_curve_up_notup %>% 
      bind_rows(roc_curve_down_notdown %>% 
                  filter(model != "Human")),
    by = join_by(pathogen, model, timepoint, comparison)) %>% 
    mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("Human", "Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation")),
         comparison = factor(comparison, levels = c("Up", "Down")),
         # timepoint = str_replace(timepoint, "Early hours", "Early\nhours"),
         timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, c("Early hours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
         pathogen = case_when(pathogen == "Hepatitis B" ~ "HepB",
                              pathogen == "Staphylococcus aureus" ~ "S. aureus",
                              pathogen == "Escherichia coli" ~ "E. coli",
                              T ~ pathogen),
         pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "HepB", "S. aureus", "E. coli", "Burn", "Trauma")) %>% 
  mutate(auc = round(auc, 2) %>% as.character())
```

## Regression model

```{r}
#Import
pairwise_human_fit_test = readRDS(here("FIT_Mouse2man", "pairwise_human_fit_measures.rds"))
pairwise_human_fit_measures = pairwise_human_fit_test
pairwise_human_fit_test$symbol %>% unique() %>% length() #6373

# Calculate metrics --------
#FIT------
#Define ranges of values for combinatorial analysis
filter_conditions_fit <- expand_grid(
  padj_fit = c(0.01, 0.05, seq(0.1, 1, by = 0.1)),
  expr_cutoff = c(0.01, seq(0.05, 0.5, by = 0.05), 0.75, 1),
  ci_percentile = c(0.3, 1.0),
  timepoint = c(1, 3, 7)
)

#Run analysis
filter_conditions_results_fit_degs <- filter_conditions_fit %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  do({
    fc <- .
    
    # Filter timepoint
    data_timepoint <- pairwise_human_fit_test %>%
      filter(timepoint == fc$timepoint)

    # Calculate the cutoff for each percentile
    ci_cutoff <- quantile(data_timepoint$ci_width_fit, probs = fc$ci_percentile, na.rm = TRUE)

    # Apply cutoffs
    filtered_data <- data_timepoint %>%
      filter(
        pval_adj_fit < fc$padj_fit,
        abs(mean_fit) > fc$expr_cutoff,
        ci_width_fit <= ci_cutoff
      )

    if (nrow(filtered_data) >= 2) {
      metrics <- filtered_data %>%
        summarise(
          n_genes = n(),
          RMSE = rmse_vec(mean_human, mean_fit),
          MAE = mae_vec(mean_human, mean_fit),
          R2 = rsq_vec(mean_human, mean_fit),
          Spearman = cor(mean_human, mean_fit, method = "spearman"),
          Pearson = cor(mean_human, mean_fit, method = "pearson")
        )
    } else {
      metrics <- tibble(
        n_genes = 0,
        RMSE = NA, MAE = NA, R2 = NA,
        Spearman = NA, Pearson = NA
      )
    }

    bind_cols(fc, tibble(ci_width_cutoff = ci_cutoff), metrics)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(organism = "FIT") %>%
  rename(padj_cutoff = padj_fit) %>% 
  mutate(ci_percentile = paste0(ci_percentile * 100, "%"))
#Print
filter_conditions_results_fit_degs

#Mouse --------
filter_conditions_mouse <- expand_grid(
  padj_mouse = c(0.01, 0.05, seq(0.1, 1, by = 0.1)),
  expr_cutoff = c(0.01, seq(0.05, 0.5, by = 0.05), 0.75, 1),
  ci_percentile = c(0.3, 1.0),
  timepoint = c(1, 3, 7)
)

filter_conditions_results_mouse_degs <- filter_conditions_mouse %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  do({
    fc <- .
    
    # Filtrar apenas dados do timepoint atual
    data_timepoint <- pairwise_human_fit_test %>%
      filter(timepoint == fc$timepoint)

    # Calcular o cutoff do percentil escolhido
    ci_cutoff <- quantile(data_timepoint$ci_width_mouse, probs = fc$ci_percentile, na.rm = TRUE)

    # Aplicar filtros
    filtered_data <- data_timepoint %>%
      filter(
        pval_adj_mouse < fc$padj_mouse,
        abs(mean_mouse) > fc$expr_cutoff,
        ci_width_mouse <= ci_cutoff
      )

    if (nrow(filtered_data) >= 2) {
      metrics <- filtered_data %>%
        summarise(
          n_genes = n(),
          RMSE = rmse_vec(mean_human, mean_mouse),
          MAE = mae_vec(mean_human, mean_mouse),
          R2 = rsq_vec(mean_human, mean_mouse),
          Spearman = cor(mean_human, mean_mouse, method = "spearman"),
          Pearson = cor(mean_human, mean_mouse, method = "pearson")
        )
    } else {
      metrics <- tibble(
        n_genes = 0,
        RMSE = NA, MAE = NA, R2 = NA,
        Spearman = NA, Pearson = NA
      )
    }

    bind_cols(fc, tibble(ci_width_cutoff = ci_cutoff), metrics)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(organism = "Mouse") %>%
  rename(padj_cutoff = padj_mouse) %>%
```

```{r}
corr_plots_data = pairwise_human_fit_test %>%
  select(symbol, timepoint, mean_mouse, mean_human, mean_fit,
         pval_adj_human, pval_adj_mouse, pval_adj_fit) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pval_adj_human, pval_adj_mouse, pval_adj_fit),
               names_to = "measure",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    pval_cuts = case_when(
      value <= 0.01 ~ "0.01",
      value <= 0.05 ~ "0.05",
      TRUE ~ "1"
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = measure,
    values_from = pval_cuts,
    values_fn = list
  ) %>%
  unnest(cols = c(pval_adj_human, pval_adj_mouse, pval_adj_fit)) %>% 
  fill(pval_adj_human, .direction = "down") %>% 
  fill(pval_adj_mouse, .direction = "up") %>% 
  fill(pval_adj_fit, .direction = "up") %>% 
  mutate(pval_cuts_mouse_human = if_else(pval_adj_human == pval_adj_mouse, pval_adj_human, "Not equal"),
         pval_cuts_fit_human = if_else(pval_adj_human == pval_adj_fit, pval_adj_fit, "Not equal"),
```

## Classification model


### Classify by grid of cutoffs
```{r}
# Define cutoffs
padj_cutoffs <- c(0.05)
l2fc_cutoffs <- c(0, 0.5)
ci_percentiles <- c(0.3, 1.0)

# Expand grid
cutoff_grid <- expand_grid(
  padj_cutoff = padj_cutoffs,
  l2fc_cutoff = l2fc_cutoffs,
  ci_percentile = ci_percentiles
)

# Classify by every combination
base_df <- pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide

classified_df <- pmap_dfr(
  cutoff_grid,
  function(padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff, ci_percentile) {
    
    ci_cutoff <- quantile(base_df$ci_width, probs = ci_percentile, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    base_df %>%
      filter(ci_width <= ci_cutoff) %>%
      mutate(
        padj_cutoff = padj_cutoff,
        l2fc_cutoff = l2fc_cutoff,
        ci_percentile = ci_percentile,
        classification = case_when(
          pval_adj < padj_cutoff & l2fc >= l2fc_cutoff  ~ "up",
          pval_adj < padj_cutoff & l2fc < -l2fc_cutoff ~ "down",
          TRUE                                          ~ "neutral"
    ))})

#Save
classified_df %>% 
  saveRDS(here("FIT_Mouse2man", "genes_l2fc_fit_mouse_human_classified_cutoffs.rds"))
```

```{r}
#Pivot wider
classified_wide <- classified_df %>%
  select(symbol, timepoint, padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff, organism, classification) %>%
  filter(l2fc_cutoff == 0) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "organism", values_from = "classification") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Human) & !is.na(FIT) & !is.na(Mouse)) %>% 
  mutate(
    fit_correct = FIT == Human,
    mouse_correct = Mouse == Human
  )

classified_wide %>% glimpse()

classified_eval = classified_wide

my_metrics <- metric_set(accuracy, precision, recall, f_meas, spec, sens)

### FIT
# "up" vs all
acc_up_vs_all_fit <- classified_eval %>%
  mutate(
    truth = factor(ifelse(Human == "up", "up", "not_up"), levels = c("up", "not_up")),
    estimate = factor(ifelse(FIT == "up", "up", "not_up"), levels = c("up", "not_up"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(timepoint, padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff) %>%
  my_metrics(truth = truth, estimate = estimate) %>%
  mutate(model = "FIT", target = "up")
# "down" vs all
acc_down_vs_all_fit <- classified_eval %>%
  mutate(
    truth = factor(ifelse(Human == "down", "down", "not_down"), levels = c("down", "not_down")),
    estimate = factor(ifelse(FIT == "down", "down", "not_down"), levels = c("down", "not_down"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(timepoint, padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff) %>%
  my_metrics(truth = truth, estimate = estimate) %>%
  mutate(model = "FIT", target = "down")

acc_fit_results <- bind_rows(acc_up_vs_all_fit, acc_down_vs_all_fit)

fit_classification_degs_ngenes <- classified_eval %>%
  mutate(
    truth = factor(Human, levels = c("up", "down", "neutral")),
    estimate = factor(FIT, levels = c("up", "down", "neutral")),
    correct = truth == estimate,
    incorrect = truth != estimate
  ) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff, truth) %>%
  summarise(
    num_correct_tp = sum(correct, na.rm = T),
    num_incorrect_fp = sum(incorrect, na.rm = T),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(model = "FIT")


fit_classification_degs_ngenes = bind_rows(fit_classification_degs_ngenes)

fit_classification_degs = acc_fit_results %>% 
  rename(truth = target) %>% 
  inner_join(fit_classification_degs_ngenes,
             by = join_by("model", "timepoint", "padj_cutoff", "l2fc_cutoff", "truth"))

fit_classification_degs %>% 
  arrange(-.estimate) %>% 
  filter(num_correct_tp > 0)
```

```{r}
# Suponha um exemplo
log2fc <- 1.2
ci_low <- 0.8
ci_high <- 1.6
se <- (ci_high - ci_low) / (2 * 1.96)

# Geração de x para a curva
x_vals <- seq(log2fc - 4*se, log2fc + 4*se, length.out = 500)
y_vals <- dnorm(x_vals, mean = log2fc, sd = se)

# Criar o data.frame
df_curve <- data.frame(x = x_vals, y = y_vals)

# Plot
ggplot(df_curve, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(ci_low, ci_high), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = log2fc, linetype = "solid", color = "black") +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(title = "Normal distribution from log2FC ± CI",
       x = "log2 Fold Change",
       y = "Density")
```


```{r}
#Manual example
dge_long_genes_up_example = dge_long_genes_down%>% 
  filter(organism == "Human",
         symbol == "TLR4") %>% 
  slice(3)

# Parameters
condition = dge_long_genes_up_example$condition
log2fc <- dge_long_genes_up_example$log2fc
# log2fc <- -0.15
ci_low <- dge_long_genes_up_example$ci_low
ci_high <- dge_long_genes_up_example$ci_high
z = dge_long_genes_up_example$z
pval_one_sided = pnorm(z, lower.tail = T) #one sided, higher
se <- dge_long_genes_up_example$se
direction = dge_long_genes_up_example$direction
df <- 120  #samples

# Null parameters
se_null <- se # Same SE
ci_low_null <- 0 - qt(0.975, df) * se_null
ci_high_null <- 0 + qt(0.975, df) * se_null

# x values (scaled for t-distribution)
x_vals <- seq(log2fc - 4*se, log2fc + 4*se, length.out = 500)
x_vals_null <- seq(-4*se, 4*se, length.out = 500)

# t-distribution densities
y_vals <- dt((x_vals - log2fc)/se, df = df) / se
y_vals_null <- dt(x_vals_null / se_null, df = df) / se_null

# Data frames
df_curve_gene <- data.frame(x = x_vals, y = y_vals, distribution = "Observed")
df_curve_null <- data.frame(x = x_vals_null, y = y_vals_null, distribution = "Null")
actual_null_dist <- bind_rows(df_curve_gene, df_curve_null)

# Plot

# Destaque da cauda inferior da distribuição nula
shade_df_superior <- df_curve_null %>%
  filter(x >= log2fc) 

shade_df_inferior <- df_curve_gene %>%
  filter(x <= log2fc) 

ggplot(actual_null_dist, aes(x = x, y = y, color = distribution)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  
  # Área sombreada da cauda superior
  geom_area(data = shade_df_superior, aes(x = x, y = y), fill = "black", alpha = 0.3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  
  # Área sombreada da cauda inferior
  geom_area(data = shade_df_inferior, aes(x = x, y = y), fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  
  # Linhas de referência
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(ci_high_null), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(ci_low), linetype = "dashed", color = "lightblue") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = log2fc, linetype = "solid", color = "lightblue") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black") +
  
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(title = paste0(condition, ", ", "adj_pval = ", as.character(pval_one_sided), ", ", direction),
       subtitle = condition,
       x = "log2 Fold Change",
       y = "Density") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Observed" = "lightblue", "Null" = "black"))

```


Automated
Generate distributions for multiple genes
```{r}

#Plot T distributions
plot_t_distribution <- function(df, df_samples = 10, n_points = 500) {
  # df: data frame containing condition, log2fc, ci_low, ci_high, se columns
  # df_samples: degrees of freedom for t-distribution (default 120)
  # n_points: number of points for the curves
  
  # Function to create a plot for one row (one condition)
  create_plot <- function(row) {
    condition <- row$condition
    log2fc <- row$log2fc
    ci_low <- row$ci_low
    ci_high <- row$ci_high
    se <- row$se
    adj_p_val = row$adj_p_val
    direction = row$direction
    df <- df_samples
    
    
    # Null parameters (mean=0, same SE)
    se_null <- se
    ci_low_null <- 0 - qt(0.975, df) * se_null
    ci_high_null <- 0 + qt(0.975, df) * se_null
    
    # x ranges for observed and null
    x_vals <- seq(log2fc - 4*se, log2fc + 4*se, length.out = n_points)
    x_vals_null <- seq(-4*se_null, 4*se_null, length.out = n_points)
    
    # t-distribution densities
    y_vals <- dt((x_vals - log2fc) / se, df = df) / se
    y_vals_null <- dt(x_vals_null / se_null, df = df) / se_null
    
    # Data frames for plotting
    df_curve_gene <- data.frame(x = x_vals, y = y_vals, distribution = "Observed")
    df_curve_null <- data.frame(x = x_vals_null, y = y_vals_null, distribution = "Null")
    actual_null_dist <- bind_rows(df_curve_gene, df_curve_null)
    
    # Plot
    p <- ggplot(actual_null_dist, aes(x = x, y = y, color = distribution)) +
      geom_line(size = 1.2) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(ci_high_null), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(ci_low), linetype = "dashed", color = "lightblue") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = log2fc, linetype = "solid", color = "lightblue") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black") +
      theme_vaxgo() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
            legend.position = "top") +
      labs(title = paste0(condition, ", ", "adj_pval = ", round(adj_p_val, 4), ", ", direction),
           x = "log2 Fold Change",
           y = "Density") +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("Observed" = "lightblue", "Null" = "black"))
    
    return(p)
  }
  
  # Apply the plotting function to each row
  plots <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) create_plot(df[i, ]))
  
  # Optionally, name the list by conditions
  names(plots) <- df$condition
  
  return(plots)
}
```

Run
```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=12}

  filter(symbol == "TLR8") %>%

  plot_annotation(title = df_example$symbol, theme = theme(legend.position = "top"))
```

#### Confusion matrix
```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(purrr) # Make sure this line is run before using reduce

##### Function
#Get summaries
get_confmat_summary <- function(data, model_selected, timepoint_selected) {
  data %>%
    filter(model == model_selected, timepoint == timepoint_selected) %>%
    conf_mat(truth, predicted) %>% # Assumes 'truth' and 'predicted' columns exist
    summary() %>% 
    mutate(model = model_selected,
           timepoint = timepoint_selected)
}


# Plot heatmap for every combination
plot_xconfmat_heatmap <- function(data, 
                                 model_selected, 
                                 timepoint_selected) {
  
  data %>%
    filter(model == model_selected, timepoint == timepoint_selected) %>%
    conf_mat(truth, predicted) %>%
    autoplot(type = "heatmap") +
    aes(
      fill = Freq,
      x = fct_rev(str_to_upper(Prediction)),
      y = str_to_upper(Truth),
      label = Freq
    ) +
    geom_tile(color = "black") +
    geom_text() +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top", expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(
      x = "Predicted",
      y = "Truth",
      title = paste(model_selected, "Day", timepoint_selected)
    ) +
    theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.line.x = element_blank(),
      axis.line.y = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1)
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "white",
      high = "#80a1d4",
      n.breaks = 3
    )
}
```
